tools.name: fgai_list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists the FlowGuideAI workspaces the authenticated user can access, each with its plan tier and the actions allowed for the user. Use first when the user asks about their FGAI workspaces or you need workspace context for another action. Triggers on phrases like: my workspaces, which workspace, list my workspaces.

tools.name: fgai_get_document
tools.description: Retrieves one FlowGuideAI document by ID — its template structure, current content, version history, and audit metadata. Use when the user wants to read, review, or reference an existing FGAI document. Triggers on phrases like: open [doc], pull up [doc], show me my [doc name].

document_id.description: The document ID from list_workspaces or search_documents

tools.name: fgai_search_documents
tools.description: Searches the user's FlowGuideAI documents by keyword or framework/category; exact-title matches rank first. Use when the user wants to find one of their existing FGAI documents. Triggers on phrases like: find my doc, search my docs, where's my SOC 2, do I have a doc on X, look up my [doc].

tools.name: fgai_get_compliance_gap_analysis
tools.description: Runs a compliance gap analysis on a FlowGuideAI document, flagging SOC 2 controls that are missing or only partially covered (keyword analysis is real; evidence IDs are illustrative in the current preview and are returned marked as such — "ILLUSTRATIVE-" prefix plus an illustrative flag in the output). Use when the user asks how compliant a document is or what is missing. Triggers on phrases like: gap analysis, what's missing, am I SOC 2 ready, check my compliance, how compliant am I. Available on the Enterprise plan; otherwise returns a plan-access response.

tools.name: fgai_get_templates
tools.description: Lists the FlowGuideAI templates available in a workspace, optionally filtered by framework or category, with their required fields. Use before drafting so generated content fits the template, or when the user asks what FGAI can produce. Triggers on phrases like: what templates, show templates, what documents can FGAI make, list document types.

tools.name: fgai_save_ai_draft
tools.description: Saves AI-drafted content into FlowGuideAI as a new versioned document structured to a template — pass the content directly, or let FGAI generate it from a description. Use when the user wants to save or keep something you just wrote; creates a draft for human review. Triggers on phrases like: save this draft, save to FGAI, keep this doc, save what you just wrote. Available on the Lite plan or higher; on Free this returns a plan-access response.

template_name.description: Template to use (e.g., "SOC 2 Type II Readiness", "HIPAA Security Assessment", "Incident Response Plan")

description.description: What this document is for and any specific requirements. If content is also provided, this is metadata only.

title.description: OPTIONAL. Explicit document title. If omitted, FGAI infers the title from the first Markdown # H1 in content. If neither is present, falls back to "<Template Name> — <Month Year>". STRONGLY recommended to provide an explicit title for clear naming.

answers.description: Pre-filled answers to guided template questions

content.description: OPTIONAL. Pre-drafted document content. If you have already drafted the content, pass it here — FGAI will save it directly without re-generating. RECOMMENDED for multi-page documents to reduce latency. If omitted, FGAI uses server-side AI to generate content from description + answers.

tools.name: fgai_update_document
tools.description: Updates the content of an existing FlowGuideAI document, creating a new revision while preserving prior versions. Use when the user wants to edit, revise, or replace an existing FGAI document. Triggers on phrases like: update the doc, revise it, change section X, edit my [doc]. Available on the Lite plan or higher; on Free this returns a plan-access response.

tools.name: fgai_cross_document_fill
tools.description: Reuses content from one FlowGuideAI document to populate matching fields in another document or template. Use when the user wants to carry approved language across documents (e.g. reuse SOC 2 wording in a HIPAA policy); creates draft updates for review. Triggers on phrases like: use my SOC 2 to fill this, carry over from [doc], prefill from my other doc, reuse my answers. Available on the Professional plan or higher; otherwise returns a plan-access response.

source_document_id.description: Source document with existing compliance content

tools.name: fgai_request_approval
tools.description: Submits a FlowGuideAI document into its workspace approval workflow for review and sign-off, optionally routing through a specific workflow. Use when the user wants to send a document for approval. Triggers on phrases like: send for approval, submit for review, get sign-off, route this for approval. Available on the Enterprise plan; otherwise returns a plan-access response.

workflow_id.description: Approval workflow id to use (call fgai_list_approval_workflows first to see options). If omitted and only one workflow exists, that one is used; if multiple exist with no default, the response lists choices.

approver_note.description: Note to the approver explaining what to review

tools.name: fgai_list_approval_workflows
tools.description: Lists the approval workflows configured for a workspace (organization-wide and workspace-specific). Use before submitting for approval so the user can pick a workflow, or when the user asks what is awaiting sign-off. Triggers on phrases like: pending approvals, what's awaiting sign-off, approval queue. Available on the Enterprise plan; otherwise returns a plan-access response.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to list approval workflows for. Returns both organization-wide workflows and workspace-specific ones.

tools.name: fgai_get_template_schema
tools.description: Retrieves the field schema (field IDs, types, options, required flags) for a FlowGuideAI template. Use before drafting for a template to learn what to collect from the user and how to structure the output. Triggers on phrases like: what does [template] ask, what info do I need for a [doc type].

tools.name: fgai_attach_evidence
tools.description: Attaches an evidence URL (HTTPS) to a FlowGuideAI document for the compliance audit trail. Use when the user wants to link a screenshot, policy, or attestation that is already hosted at a URL to a document. Triggers on phrases like: attach this, add evidence, link this screenshot to the doc. Available on the Lite plan or higher; on Free this returns a plan-access response.

evidence_url.description: HTTPS URL to the evidence file or resource

description.description: Brief description of what this evidence shows

tools.name: fgai_upload_evidence
tools.description: Uploads a binary evidence file (PDF, screenshot, diagram, etc.; base64, max 50 MB) directly to FlowGuideAI and optionally links it to a document. Use when the user has an actual file to add as evidence; for a URL already hosted elsewhere, use attach instead. Triggers on phrases like: upload this file as evidence, add this file to my evidence. Available on the Business plan or higher; otherwise returns a plan-access response.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to upload the evidence file to

file_name.description: Original filename including the extension (e.g., diagram.png)

mime_type.description: MIME type. If omitted, inferred from the file extension.

description.description: Brief description of what this evidence shows

link_to_document_id.description: Optional: document id to link this evidence to immediately

tools.name: fgai_archive_document
tools.description: Archives (soft-deletes) a FlowGuideAI document — hidden from active listings but retained with full audit and revision history, reversible, and pending approvals are withdrawn. Use when the user wants to remove or delete a document. Triggers on phrases like: archive it, delete the doc, remove this document. Available on the Lite plan or higher; on Free this returns a plan-access response.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded with the audit log

tools.name: fgai_restore_document
tools.description: Restores a previously archived FlowGuideAI document to active listings (pending approvals are not auto-resubmitted). Use when the user wants to undelete or bring back an archived document. Triggers on phrases like: restore it, undelete, bring back the doc I deleted. Available on the Lite plan or higher; on Free this returns a plan-access response.

document_id.description: Document to restore (must be currently archived)

reason.description: Optional reason recorded with the audit log

tools.name: fgai_document_this
tools.description: Captures whatever the user just described into the best-matching FlowGuideAI MCP template — picks the section and extracts structured field values from the free text; pass any table or column context. Build the description from the full recent working context — decisions, parameter values, and results from other tools in the session (e.g., engineering/CAD analyses), not just the last message; richer context makes a more complete document. Use when the user asks to write up, capture, or save what just happened. Returns the matched template and section, extracted field values, whether the capture persisted or requires template confirmation, and ranked alternate_templates; if the match is wrong, call again with template_id to switch (Professional plan and above). If the best match is a template above the user's plan, the capture degrades to an open-format document and tier_limited names what upgrading unlocks. Triggers on phrases like: FGAI document this, document this, doc it, doc this, FGAI doc it, write this up, capture this, capture this session, save this to FGAI, save this session. Short forms like 'doc it' are equivalent to the full phrase — do not ask the user to rephrase. Treat close homophones ('docket', 'dock it') as this request when context indicates capture. Available on the Lite plan or higher; on Free this returns a plan-access response.

description.description: What the user just did — in their own words, any order. The classifier extracts structured field values from this text.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to save the captured document into.

active_document_id.description: If the user is already working in a specific document, pass its id so new captures append to it (or trigger a topic-drift confirmation when content clearly belongs elsewhere).

table_context.description: Optional table/dataset reference the user mentioned (e.g., "clinical.trials.patient_cohorts").

column_context.description: Optional column names from the user's context (e.g., ["fraud_score", "false_positive"]).

auto_save.description: When true and confidence ≥0.85, persist the capture without asking again. Defaults to false; pass true after the user confirms a template choice.

template_id.description: Professional plan and above: explicitly use this template id instead of auto-matching — pass when the user says the matched template was wrong and picks another (ids come from alternate_templates in a prior response or the template list). Below Professional it is not honored.
